name: rules-team-tasks-seeded
description: Experiment A (#787): identical to rules-team-tasks but the workspace STARTS with a 2+modules stub — measures whether pattern-completion (vs instruction) gets agents to keep/extend imports.
prompt: Author firestore.rules for a team task tracker. Data model: /teams/{teamId} docs have a `members` map of uid -> role ('admin' or 'editor'). /teams/{teamId}/tasks/{taskId} docs have `title` (string 1-80 chars), `status` ('open' | 'done'), and `author` (uid). Requirements: only team members may read team docs and tasks; any member may create a task but the task's author must be their own uid and the title/status must be valid; only the task's author may update a task (title/status only — author immutable); only team admins may delete tasks. Check the rules stdlib before writing — import what fits. Write the rules to /workspace/firestore.rules and lint them.
